classData.description: Shared field definitions for timeline event and task models. Exported as a plain array so models that extend Neo.data.TreeModel (such as Gantt tasks) can spread the shared timeline schema alongside hierarchy fields without single-inheritance conflicts.
classData.name: timelineFields

classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Shared timeline event record schema.
 * @description Defines the canonical temporal record fields (`id`, `title`, `description`, `startDate`,
 * `endDate`, `allDay`, `resourceId`). Also exports
 * `timelineFields` so `Neo.data.TreeModel` subclasses in Gantt can spread the exact same temporal fields.
 * @class Neo.timeline.model.Event
 * @extends Neo.data.Model
 */
classData.description: Defines the canonical temporal record fields (id, title, description, startDate, endDate, allDay, resourceId). Also exports timelineFields so Neo.data.TreeModel subclasses in Gantt can spread the exact same temporal fields.
